title: Sandustry Slag & Processing — Byproduct Bottlenecks
description: How slag and byproducts clog Sandustry factories, and high-level processing habits for Early Access.

sections.h2: Byproducts are part of the loop
paragraphs: Factory sandboxes punish players who only chase the valuable output. Slag and other residuals fill belts, bury buildings, and fake “I need more dig” problems.
Filter and sink byproducts on purpose.
Give slag its own lane or dump before it backfills the gold path.
Do not merge unsorted dig output into a single long belt forever.
When throughput drops, inspect junctions for the wrong material first.
Revisit processing buildings after each major unlock — EA often adds better sinks.
Exact slag recipes and machine names belong on the official wiki and in-game tooltips.
This page stays principle-level so it does not invent patch-sensitive ratios.

faq.q: Should I store slag or destroy it?
faq.a: Depends on the current patch — some byproducts become feedstock later. Until you know, isolate it so it cannot stall the main line.
